tools.name: binary_cube_compare_subcube_strength
tools.description: Compare fan-out 1 against a candidate subcube multi-input fan-out using the same source and canonical Binary Cube key; reports exact recovery, expansion cost, pre-cube perturbation and normalized ciphertext diffusion.
tools.outputDescription: Structured baseline/candidate comparison with diffusion summaries, round-trip status, coverage, expansion and findings.

notes: This tool measures a strengthening hypothesis; it does not establish cryptographic security.
Do not promote subcube indexing into ordinary encryption solely because fan-out is greater than one.
